guitar.notes: Iconic, extremely well documented: Selmer-Maccaferri oval/D-hole guitars define gypsy jazz guitar identity.

tone.summary: A very clean signal chain utilizing compression for attack definition, followed by a low-gain, warm amp model (US Deluxe) paired with an appropriate cabinet (US 2x12). The focus is on maximizing transient response and maintaining a dry, vintage mono feel while avoiding all modern effects.
corrections: this is acoustic guitar not electric

rig.name: Django Reinhardt - Minor Swing - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: To enhance the attack and sustain of the plucked strings, mimicking close-miking techniques used on acoustic instruments.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is general; specific acoustic compression modeling would be ideal but unavailable.

blocks.purpose: To boost the high-end clarity and definition (treble) crucial for fast fingerpicking, while slightly rounding out the low end.
blocks.gap: A dedicated acoustic EQ would be better, but Guitar EQ 1 provides necessary tonal shaping.

blocks.purpose: To ensure zero drive or distortion is introduced, maintaining the pure acoustic tone.

blocks.purpose: To simulate the close-miking environment of a vintage studio recording and provide a focused, non-boomy sound.
blocks.gap: A dedicated acoustic cabinet IR would be ideal, but US 2x12 is the best clean/vintage option available.

blocks.purpose: All modulation and ambience effects (Reverb, Delay) must be bypassed to achieve the dry 1930s studio feel.
